policy.audit: single trap cannot confirm or clear statistical certificate memory
policy.certificate: strict full-peer separation for norm; unchanged v15.1 profile gate; diagonal diagnostic only
policy.diagonal: diagnostic only; not independent evidence of low norm
policy.followup: bounded v15.1 review; no median-only individual confirmation
policy.memory_clearance: configured clean-cycle count of consecutive full R cycles; C pauses but does not erase certificates
policy.memory_lifetime: until clean-cycle clearance or removal; no round-based expiry
policy.norm_certificate: existing core gap > cohort IQR AND full-peer gap > cohort IQR; no density alternative
policy.quarantine: unchanged bounded review; stored certificates cannot renew exclusion or force probing
policy.references: all active clients, no label or passing-only filter
policy.removal: same statistical component freshly certified on both traps in configured number of distinct full cycles; adjacency not required
policy.review: bounded followup; weak evidence cannot renew its own exclusion
policy.risk: persistent correlated false certificates may accumulate; no recall or false-positive guarantee
policy.weak_evidence: screening only; no removal strike or automatic quarantine
